title: enter_demo bypasses the navigation reset every other route change performs (dropdowns, consent modal, focus trap)
evidence: routes.Demo, False -> enter_demo(model, route) ... fn enter_demo(model: Model, route: Route) -> #(Model, Effect(Msg)) { ... Model( ..model, route:, auth: Success(landlord), csrf_token: "demo-csrf-token", demo_mode: True, demo_store: Some(store), ... vacancy_edit_id: edit_id, ) -- versus handle_browser_change: Model( ..model, route:, show_avatar_dropdown: False, show_mobile_menu: False, show_notification_dropdown: False, show_help_menu: False, ... unlock_consent_modal_open: None, ...) and: let eff = case any_consent_modal_open { True -> effect.batch([ eff, effect.from(fn(_dispatch) { policy_reaccept_modal_focus.uninstall() }), ]) False -> eff }
detail: SPA navigation to /demo skips handle_browser_change's reset: open dropdown flags, pending confirms, and consent-modal state survive into the demo, and an installed modal focus trap is never uninstalled — keyboard focus stays captured.
recommended_fix: Apply the same navigation-reset on demo entry (or route entry through handle_browser_change) so chrome state is cleared and the focus trap is torn down when entering /demo.

Cheap defence against /// the multi-tab footgun: if tab A accepts the policy, tab B (which would /// otherwise sit on the old modal forever) picks up the new /// server_policy_version the moment the landlord switches back to it. fn handle_browser_change( -- and the same four lines were removed from above fn listen_visibility_refresh() -> Effect(Msg) {

title: Demo boot deep links never fire the per-surface analytics events that in-demo navigation fires
location: client/src/client.gleam: demo_entry_effects vs handle_browser_change route arms (@@ -5346,100 +4931,977 @@)
evidence: handle_browser_change: case updated_model.demo_mode { True -> { demo_analytics.capture_event(demo_analytics.demo_vacancy_open) demo_api.get_detail(...) -- demo_entry_effects: routes.VacancyDetail(id) | routes.VacancyHandoff(id) -> [ demo_api.get_detail(store, id, ApiReturnedVacancyDetail), demo_api.fetch_leaderboard(store, id, ApiReturnedLeaderboard), ] (no capture_event in any demo_entry_effects route arm)
detail: A deep-linked demo open (shared /vacancies/v-maples URL) counts only demo_entry while the identical in-session navigation counts demo_vacancy_open/demo_application_open — engagement metrics undercount the primary entry path.
recommended_fix: Fire the matching demo_analytics capture_event inside demo_entry_effects' route arms (or once in enter_demo based on route).

title: Unreachable routes.Demo arm in view_protected_page duplicates the demo render
evidence: view_page: routes.Demo -> view_demo_page(model) // Protected routes — show login if not authenticated _ -> case model.auth { -- view_protected_page: let content = case route { routes.Demo -> dashboard.view_dashboard(model) routes.Dashboard -> dashboard.view_dashboard(model)
detail: view_page matches routes.Demo before its protected catch-all, so view_protected_page never receives Demo; its Demo arm duplicates the dashboard render and exists only to satisfy the exhaustive match.
recommended_fix: Fold Demo into the Dashboard arm (routes.Demo | routes.Dashboard -> dashboard.view_dashboard(model)) with a comment noting view_page intercepts Demo first.

title: Demo comparison deep link fetches with persisted real localStorage ids and skips the navigation path's empty guard
evidence: demo_entry_effects: routes.Comparison(vid) -> [ demo_api.fetch_comparison( store, vid, load_comparison_ids(), ApiReturnedComparisonDetails, ), ] -- handle_browser_change: routes.Comparison(vid) -> case updated_model.comparison_ids { [] -> #(updated_model, eff)
detail: Boot path fetches unconditionally, passing a real landlord's persisted application ids from localStorage into the demo store; the navigation path skips the fetch when ids are empty. The two paths disagree.
recommended_fix: Mirror the navigation guard in demo_entry_effects (skip when load_comparison_ids() is empty) and seed demo fixture ids instead of persisted real ids.

title: Failed demo seed desyncs model.route from the browser URL
evidence: Error(_) -> #( Model(..model, route: routes.Landing, demo_mode: False, demo_store: None), effect.none(), )
detail: On seed failure the model route becomes Landing with no navigation effect — the address bar still shows /demo while Landing renders, and no session check is ever dispatched.
recommended_fix: Return modem.replace("/", None, None) from the Error arm so the rendered route matches the URL.
